reason: Expert shares a troubleshooting rule that on older transmission units, traffic counters zero with normal optical levels can be fixed by bouncing the interface instead of replacing hardware.

knowledge.summary: On older transmission equipment, when interface is up and optical levels are normal but traffic counters are zero, bounce the interface to restore traffic before attempting hardware replacement.
knowledge.author: Erkki
knowledge.details: Check traffic counters and bounce the port before replacing hardware.
